ShortDescription.Value: Adjust the capacity options for city services and modify traffic behaviors.

Publish.LongDescription:
This mod allows you to adjust various City Service Capacity options. Currently, it supports the following features:
# City Service Options
- **Post Office** - Adjust Sorting Speed (Base rate of 50k; can be increased up to 5x.) - **Cargo Terminal Station** - Adjust Truck Capacity (Base of 16 trucks; can be increased up to 5x.) - **School** - Adjust Capacity (Can be increased up to 5x.) - **Crematorium** - Adjust Burn Speed (Can be increased up to 5x.) - Adjust Hearse Multiplier (Can be increased up to 5x.) - **Transport Depot** - Adjust Depot Capacity - Adjust Public Transport Vehicle Capacity - **Garbage** - Adjust Truck Capacity
# Traffic Adjuster
Additionally, the mod allows you to mitigate some unsafe traffic behaviors, including:
- Reducing unsafe pedestrian crossings. - Reducing unsafe car behaviors (various options).
To observe changes in traffic behavior, you will need to wait for the simulation system to adjust to these new settings. Sometimes you need to save the game and load it again to force the changes.
# Comment
More options may be added in the future based on requests from the player community or the needs of the mod author.
Enjoy the game!
